trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Identified the issue**: The latest production release, v2.3.1, was unhealthy; the most recent previously healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back checkout-api** to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rollback verified as rolled out.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the health check failures on v2.3.1 and the rollback to v2.3.0; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the root cause of the v2.3.1 failures is still unknown — the on-call engineer should investigate before any re-deploy attempt.
